blocks.content: Create a program to print the item present at a given index. If the index is out of bounds, print Wrong index.

items: Create a list of four strings: 'BMW', 'Ferrari', 'Audi', 'Tesla'.
Take an integer input from the user and store it in the index variable.
Print the item present at that index.
However, if the index is out of bounds, instead of showing the default error, print Wrong Index.

blocks.content: Note: Use exception handling to solve this problem.
